تكتسحوا (form VIII)
# تَكْتَسِحُوا (taktasiḥū) /tak.ta.si.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
# تُكْتَسَحُوا (tuktasaḥū) /tuk.ta.sa.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
